##### Project general facts
The Arts Districts concept places art and culture at the centre of daily life: a pedestrian art plaza with large-scale sculptures, suspended fabric installations and art galleries forms the heart of the district, framed by buildings with deep-red awnings, open terraces and landscaped greenery. The architecture pairs slender towers wrapped in vertical fins with glazed lower levels that open onto the plaza and its galleries.

The first phase introduces studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments. Around them, the master community is planned with a shopping mall, a school and a set of world-class amenities, so that residents can reach retail, education and leisure without leaving the neighbourhood. Cafés and restaurants line the terraces overlooking the plaza, adding outdoor dining to the everyday setting.

At street level, galleries, boutiques and dining terraces turn the public spaces into a continuous cultural promenade, active from morning to evening. Landscaped seating areas, shaded walkways and lighting along the plaza create comfortable places for families to meet, walk and spend time outdoors, giving the district a lively, community-focused character.

##### Location description and benefits
Dubai International Academic City (DIAC) sits on the eastern side of Dubai and brings together a large cluster of universities and colleges, within easy reach of Dubai Silicon Oasis, Mirdif and Al Warqa. The area is served by Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road, which connect it to the rest of the emirate as well as to Sharjah and the northern emirates.

Major destinations are a short drive away, including Global Village, Dubai Outlet Mall and the retail and leisure options of Mirdif City Centre. Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai are reachable by car, and the planned Dubai Metro Blue Line is set to bring rail access to the Academic City area.

The universities and schools of DIAC make the location attractive for students, faculty and young families, while the surrounding residential communities support steady demand. Combined with Binghatti's master-planned retail, school and leisure facilities within Tilal Binghatti, this positioning gives the district appeal for both end users and investors.
